title: Fix invalid JavaScript object syntax in MDX block documentation
body:
The Next.js build was failing with acorn parse errors in 5 MDX files containing embedded schema objects. Invalid JavaScript object syntax prevented Turbopack from evaluating the code blocks.

## Changes

**Fixed double comma syntax errors** (118 occurrences)
```diff
- spacing: 6,,
+ spacing: 6,
```

**Fixed missing `children` property** (11 occurrences)
```diff
  {
    type: "stack",
-   spacing: 2, [
+   spacing: 2,
+   children: [
      { type: "text", content: "..." }
    ]
  }
```

## Files Modified
- `content/docs/blocks/authentication.mdx` (27 fixes)
- `content/docs/blocks/dashboard.mdx` (24 fixes)
- `content/docs/blocks/ecommerce.mdx` (22 fixes)
- `content/docs/blocks/forms.mdx` (31 fixes)
- `content/docs/blocks/marketing.mdx` (25 fixes)
